description: This PHP class defines a model for a work shift in the OrangeHRM system's admin API. It serializes WorkShift entity data into a standardized format for API responses, including properties like id, name, hoursPerDay, startTime, and endTime.

classes.name: WorkShiftModel
classes.description: A model class used for serializing WorkShift entity data into a structured format for API responses within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the WorkShiftModel with a WorkShift entity and sets up the filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
